note: Andbank's book of tariffs (22 January 2026), read again on 2026-10-30 for every card in its cardholders' table except the Visa Electron debit cards: the Visa Open (52 euros a year to issue and hold), Visa Open Or (100), Visa Platinum (180 euros; 225 US dollars for one in dollars, not written), Visa Solidària (52), Visa Rotary (130; for Rotary members, not checked), Visa Viatge (48) and Visa 1,2,3 (48). Each: deferred payments carry 1.80% a month (24.24% TAE), and a purchase in a currency other than the euro 4.00%. The commission of 1% on the credit limit granted, at most 90 euros a half-year, isn't written, the game holding no card limit; the Platinum VIP's 1% on billing and the insurance, duplicate and SMS charges aren't written. The main banks: Andorra's three banking groups are Andbank, Crèdit Andorrà and MoraBanc; only Andbank's tariffs were read on 2026-10-30. The earlier reading of the Visa Open (2026-10-29) holds and is kept.
